newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil '96 operational deficit 3.89% of GDP - paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil '96 operational deficit 3.89% of GDP - paper.

text.p: Brazil's public sector operational deficit in 1996 was 3.89 percent of gross domestic product (GDP) mostly due to expenses with interest payments, O Estado de Sao Paulo newspaper today said.
The operational deficit was below government's expectations of a deficit of 4.5 percent of GDP, the newspaper added.
Official figures for the public sector operational deficit are due at 1100 local/1400 GMT Friday.
Brazil posted an operational deficit of 5.0 percent of GDP in 1995.
